findings.title: Debug Mode Enabled
findings.description: APP_DEBUG is set to true. In production, this exposes detailed error pages with stack traces, environment variables, and database queries to attackers.
findings.fix_guidance: Set APP_DEBUG=false in your production .env file. Use proper logging instead of debug mode.

findings.title: Unescaped Blade Output
findings.description: Unescaped Blade output {!! !!} renders raw HTML. If the variable contains user-supplied data, this is a cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability.
findings.code_snippet: 278: @php $sel = $activeTab === $tab['id']; @endphp 279:
findings.fix_guidance: Use escaped output {{ }} instead. If raw HTML is intentional (e.g., rendering markdown), ensure the data is sanitized with a library like HTMLPurifier.

findings.title: SQL Injection via Raw Query
findings.description: User input is concatenated or interpolated directly into a raw SQL query. This allows an attacker to inject arbitrary SQL and read, modify, or delete data.
findings.fix_guidance: Use parameterized bindings: whereRaw("column = ?", [$request->input("value")]). Never concatenate user input into raw SQL strings.

findings.title: Hardcoded credential detected in source
findings.description: Credentials committed to source control are exposed to repository readers and remain recoverable from git history.
findings.fix_guidance: Move the secret to environment-backed configuration and rotate the exposed credential immediately.

findings.title: Hardcoded credential detected in source
findings.description: Credentials committed to source control are exposed to repository readers and remain recoverable from git history.
findings.fix_guidance: Move the secret to environment-backed configuration and rotate the exposed credential immediately.

findings.title: Debug mode is enabled
findings.description: APP_DEBUG=true exposes sensitive error details and stack traces. Must be false in production.

findings.title: Environment set to local
findings.description: APP_ENV=local may enable development features. Use "production" for deployed apps.

findings.title: App URL uses HTTP instead of HTTPS
findings.description: APP_URL should use HTTPS to ensure secure cookies, redirects, and asset URLs.

findings.title: File-based sessions
findings.description: File sessions are not suitable for multi-server deployments. Consider database, redis, or memcached.

findings.title: Mail driver set to log
findings.description: Emails are being written to log files instead of being sent. Not suitable for production.

findings.title: Verbose logging enabled
findings.description: Debug-level logging can leak sensitive data to log files. Use "warning" or "error" in production.

findings.title: Queue running synchronously
findings.description: Sync queue processes jobs in the request cycle, which can cause timeouts for heavy tasks.
